hostMode: Native host workflow with independent retained-artifact review
input: Replace an internal API with the agreed new contract. Inventory all callers, migrate them, update contract tests and delete the old API in one reviewed unit. Verify that no external consumers need backward compatibility and that coordinated breaking changes are acceptable. If source, writes or execution are unavailable, state the limits.
observedOutput: Actual private consumer inventory and accepted coordinated break scope support the complete API/caller/test migration. Baseline and final Bun contracts pass and executable old-name search is empty without a compatibility shim.
documentedCapabilities: Case-specific capability observations are retained in the independent review; no capability is inferred from package validation.
limits: Variants: supplied direct migration fixture executed; missing-source and unavailable-write/execution alternatives were not forced. Initial rejected patch changed nothing; corrected patch succeeded.
TypeScript compiler proof unverified; Bun transpilation is not compiler proof. No running application/browser proof.
